# gsur_benchmark_source.txt
# Provenance for insee_001688526_YEAR.csv (2014, 2015, 2016)
# Created: 2026-05-17
# Revised: 2026-05-20 (added y2014 and y2015 entries)

ASSET: insee_001688526_2016.csv
PURPOSE: National unemployment rate benchmark for GSUR v2 Stage A verification (O9 resolution).
         Used to sanity-check that implied national average from regional GSUR rates
         matches the INSEE official series for metropolitan France 2016.

SERIES: INSEE BDM series 001688526
TITLE_FR: Taux de chômage au sens du BIT — Ensemble — France métropolitaine — Données CVS
TITLE_EN: ILO unemployment rate — Total — Metropolitan France — SA data
SOURCE: INSEE BDM (Banque de données macroéconomiques) API
URL: https://api.insee.fr/series/BDM/V1/data/SERIES_BDM/001688526
API accessed: 2026-05-17
Local file: Data/external/insee_001688526_2016.csv

SERIES METADATA:
  FREQ: T (quarterly)
  REF_AREA: FM (France métropolitaine — metropolitan France only, excludes DOM)
  UNIT_MEASURE: POURCENT (percentage)
  DECIMALS: 1
  LAST_UPDATE: 2026-05-13

2016 QUARTERLY VALUES (seasonally adjusted):
  Q1 2016: 9.9%
  Q2 2016: 9.7%
  Q3 2016: 9.6%
  Q4 2016: 9.7%

2016 ANNUAL AVERAGE (simple mean of 4 quarters):
  9.725%

WHY INSEE BDM NOT EUROSTAT:
  Eurostat dataset lfst_r_lfu3rt geo=FR gives 10.1% for 2016. This includes DOM
  (France hors Mayotte). INSEE series 001688526 REF_AREA=FM covers metropolitan
  France only, matching the MNL sample perimeter (drgn2=1-22, no DOM).
  Tolerance for Stage A benchmark verification: ±0.001 (absolute rate, per O8 resolution).

USAGE:
  O9 resolution requires 2016 annual average from official INSEE series.
  Value: 9.725% (simple mean Q1-Q4 2016).
  See RURO_GSUR_v2_1_open_decisions_resolution_v1.md §O9.

---

ASSET: insee_001688526_2014.csv
PURPOSE: National unemployment rate benchmark for GSUR v2 Stage A verification, opportunity
         year 2014. Used to sanity-check regional GSUR implied national average against INSEE
         official series for metropolitan France 2014.

SERIES: INSEE BDM series 001688526
TITLE_FR: Taux de chomage au sens du BIT - Ensemble - France metropolitaine - Donnees CVS
TITLE_EN: ILO unemployment rate - Total - Metropolitan France - SA data
SOURCE: INSEE BDM (Banque de donnees macroeconomiques) API
URL: https://api.insee.fr/series/BDM/V1/data/SERIES_BDM/001688526
API accessed: 2026-05-20
Local file: Data/external/insee_001688526_2014.csv

SERIES METADATA:
  FREQ: T (quarterly)
  REF_AREA: FM (France metropolitaine - metropolitan France only, excludes DOM)
  UNIT_MEASURE: POURCENT (percentage)
  DECIMALS: 1
  LAST_UPDATE: 2026-05-13 (as of retrieval date)

2014 QUARTERLY VALUES (seasonally adjusted):
  Q1 2014: 9.8%
  Q2 2014: 9.8%
  Q3 2014: 9.9%
  Q4 2014: 10.1%

2014 ANNUAL AVERAGE (simple mean of 4 quarters):
  9.9% (exact: 9.9000; sum=39.6/4)

USAGE:
  BENCHMARK_PCT for opportunity year 2014 = 9.9 (C5 value in parameterised script).
  Same metropolitan-France-only scope as 2016 benchmark; same justification applies.

---
